policyTab.title: Workspace Staff Access Policy
policyTab.subtitle: Control how restricted screens behave in navigation and how Just-in-Time access requests work.
policyTab.modeLockDesc: Display restricted products with a lock indicator so staff can open the branded Request Access screen.
policyTab.modeHideDesc: Completely hide modules and groups the staff member cannot read.
policyTab.allowRequestsDesc: Enable staff to request feature access, role upgrades, or sub-team budget boosts.
policyTab.notifyAdminsDesc: Send in-app notifications and email alerts whenever a new request is submitted.
policyTab.defaultDurationDesc: Pre-selected expiry window when staff submit a new Just-in-Time request.
policyTab.teamScopedVisibilityDesc: Isolate generated reports, batches, projects, logs, and templates so staff see only items owned by their sub-team (unless granted All Teams access).
policyTab.requireTeamApiKeysDesc: Require external API callers to authenticate with a Team API key carrying a sub-team assignment.
